newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-NEWELL'S OLD BOYS INCREASE LEAD IN ARGENTINA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEWELL'S OLD BOYS INCREASE LEAD IN ARGENTINA.

text.p: Newell's Old Boys increased their lead at the top of the Argentine Clausura championship on Sunday when they beat Lanus 1-0 while second-placed Colon were held to a draw.
Cristian Paris scored the winner for Newell's who went three points clear as Colon drew 1-1 away to Velez Sarsfield.
Castano Suarez scored early in the game for Colon, who have never won a major title, but Martin Posse equalised on the stroke of halftime for Velez, who won both the tournaments played last season.
The Clausura is the second of the two tournaments played in the Argentine season. River Plate won this season's opening championship, known as the Apertura.
